build.name: build Owl Lisp from the pinned companion, then compile radamsa (Scheme -> C -> binary)
build.cmd: cp $BODY/upstream/ol-0.1.19.c.gz ol.c.gz && make -s bin/radamsa 2>&1 | grep -iE '\berror' | head -3; test -x bin/radamsa && echo built

runs.name: 200 deterministic mutations of a JSON seed (seed 1)
determinism: the same seed reproduces case 7 byte-for-byte

notes: PAIR half 1 (pressure). The 200 cases from seed 1 are copied into cjson-1.7.18/harness/cases/ as the tracked fixture the parser is attacked with (provenance: radamsa v0.6, -s 1, seed.json sha in the harness).
